issue.title: capture_pomodoros warning test flakes under parallel cargo test
issue.description:
## Flake report

The test `native::capture_pomodoros::tests::missing_note_and_missing_section_are_warning_successes` in `src/native/capture_pomodoros.rs` intermittently returned a count of 1 where the assertion expected 0 during the full parallel Rust unit suite. The same test passed unchanged when run alone; investigate shared environment or other parallel-test interference and make the test deterministic.

task_type_fields.evidence: Observed 1 failure in 1 full parallel just all run (1,616 passed, 1 failed), then 1 pass in 1 unchanged isolated cargo test run. It did not reproduce serially; the full-suite fail rate is 1/1 observed and serial fail rate 0/1.

issue.creation_reason: The full `just all` run failed this test once, while the unchanged test passed on an isolated rerun. This intermittent failure makes the full Rust test result unreliable until the test isolation issue is understood.

payload.entry: Further evidence: Two additional unchanged full parallel suite runs also failed this test; total observed parallel result is 3 failures in 3 full runs, while the focused serial rerun passed 1 of 1. The full suite passed with RUST_TEST_THREADS=1 and NO_COLOR unset. The cause of the parallel interference remains unconfirmed.

evidence.note: Proposed by bob-cli-46.2 note #3: its full parallel just test failed native::capture_pomodoros::tests::missing_note_and_missing_section_are_warning_successes at line 1196, left 1/right 0, and its unchanged exact isolated rerun passed. Phase already added evidence to bob-cli-2e; land audit confirms the unlocked BOB_DAY_FILE mutation remains and file is untouched by bob-cli-46. Corroborates this existing flake; no additional task created.

Independent reproduction in this continuation: two further unchanged default just all runs both failed native::capture_pomodoros::tests::missing_note_and_missing_section_are_warning_successes at line 1196 with left 1/right 0; the exact filtered cargo test passed 1/1 unchanged. The failure occurs before this test's own BOB_DAY_FILE override, and this module's with_env helper does not acquire a process-wide environment lock. The systemic cause remains unconfirmed.

Independent reproduction during install_all restart-on-plugin-change implementation: just all failed native::capture_pomodoros::tests::missing_note_and_missing_section_are_warning_successes at src/native/capture_pomodoros.rs:1196 with left 2 / right 0. Isolated cargo test --lib missing_note_and_missing_section_are_warning_successes then passed 1/1 unchanged, and a subsequent just test passed.

Independently observed by bob-cli-4i.4 (note #1): native::capture_pomodoros::tests::missing_note_and_missing_section_are_warning_successes failed in a full parallel cargo test --lib run on clean base fbc4f43^ (verified with git stash), then passed in the bob-cli-4i land agent's full cargo test run on fbc4f43 (1710 passed, only the unrelated kinds failure). Same BOB_DAY_FILE race that bob-cli-2e describes.

Proposed by bob-cli-4q.4 note #2: unchanged full parallel just all failed the capture_pomodoros missing-note warning test while isolation passed. This lander confirmed the exact serial cargo test passes on ade4b8a; capture_pomodoros.rs is untouched by inbox routing and still tests missing-note before its BOB_DAY_FILE override. Same existing flake; no new task.

Proposed by bob-cli-4s.2 #2 and bob-cli-4s.4 #3: missing_note_and_missing_section_are_warning_successes fails in parallel full-suite runs but passes alone, the same on a clean base. Reproduced again by bob-cli-4s.land: just all on master fe1c05f failed this test in the parallel lib suite (1758 passed, 3 failed). The highlights epic does not touch capture_pomodoros.

Proposed by bob-cli-4w.3 #5, .5 #3, .6 #2, .9 #1. Independently reproduced by bob-cli-4w.land on master e3e69df: the full parallel just all lib run failed native::capture_pomodoros::tests::missing_note_and_missing_section_are_warning_successes (assertion at src/native/capture_pomodoros.rs:1196); an isolated --exact rerun on the unchanged tree passed 1/1.

Proposed by bob-cli-52.2 #3, .4 #1, .5 #4, .6 #1, .7 #1. Independently observed by bob-cli-52.land on master 2d568fa: native::capture_pomodoros::tests::missing_note_and_missing_section_are_warning_successes failed (left 2, right 0, capture_pomodoros.rs:1196) in 2 of 2 full parallel cargo test --lib runs; bob-cli-52 never touched capture_pomodoros.

payload.close_reason: fixed by bob-cli-2e's shared test env isolation: same test, same BOB_DAY_FILE race, same fix; verified with the 2e stress runs (victim green every run, full lib 1874/1874 on athena)
